About Me

Working at the intersection of .NET, AI, and IoT.

I focus on optimizing complex industrial processes through modern software, AI architecture, and IoT solutions.

Technical Interests & Focus

I am actively working on and exploring systems where high-level business logic meets hardware and intelligent automation:

  • AI Engineering & GenAI: I am working on building production-ready AI systems with a focus on enterprise security (IAM, ADC) and designing a provider-agnostic framework for multi-model orchestration, integrating diverse LLMs like Google Gemini, OpenAI, and other industry-leading models.
  • Backend Ecosystem: I focus on the .NET ecosystem, high-performance APIs, and Clean Architecture to build stable and maintainable enterprise services.
  • IoT & Embedded Systems: I am interested in digitalizing physical processes using ESP32 and industrial sensors for real-time data collection and hardware-software integration.
  • System Integration: I design seamless data bridges between specialized applications and core platforms to ensure efficient process optimization.

The Blog

This blog is my personal space to document the technical challenges I encounter and the solutions I build. From deep dives into .NET internals to practical AI and IoT implementations, I share my journey as a builder and a problem solver.
